request.business_problem: Front-desk staff cannot find the right policy quickly in a folder of 200 markdown documents (billing, scheduling, consent, cancellations).
request.tasks: Let Claude search and read the policy documents in one approved folder: keyword search that returns file, title and a snippet, and a read-document tool. It must never read outside that folder.
request.existing_tools: Markdown files in a shared folder, Notion export
request.required_output: Search hits with file path, heading and a short snippet; full text on request, truncated if very long.
request.examples: Docs: cancellation-policy.md ('Cancellations under 24 hours incur a fee'), consent-forms.md, billing-faq.md

smoke.prompt: Search the policy documents for what happens when a patient cancels late.
